grades.quote: However, it remains the only standard instruction-fetch coherence mechanism.
grades.reason: Preface changelog entry. It says FENCE.I is the only standard instruction-fetch coherence mechanism and moved to Zifencei. This is limited background. It does not say whether FENCE.I synchronizes other harts, which is local-only.
It covers memory-ordering PMAs for main memory and I/O regions, as used by FENCE and atomics. It does not mention FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
